title: Resource Allocation
alt: Resource Allocation Area State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Resource Allocation Logic (Dough Mixing)

The Resource Allocation Area controls the precise dosing of flour and sugar via pneumatic transfer.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Flour Vacuum Transfer: When vacuum_pump is active and rv_1 (Rotary Valve 1) is open, flour is drawn into the scale hopper. System holds state until target weight is reached via load cells.
  • Mixing Cycle: Once ingredients are verified (Grav_Feed complete), the Mixer_Motor engages. This is a latched state that runs for a set duration or until motor torque indicates proper dough consistency.
  • Discharge (Trough Dump): Upon mix completion, the mixer bowl tilts (Actuator trough_transfer) to dump dough into the transport trough. This action requires a safety interlock (!dv) to prevent dumping while the valve is closed.

title: Production Area
alt: Production Area State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Production Area Logic (Baking & Freezing)

This critical zone manages the 'Kill Step' via temperature regulation and nitrogen injection.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Temperature PID Loop: The PLC continuously monitors the internal freezer temperature. If the temperature rises above the setpoint, gv_1 (Nitrogen Gas Valve) modulates open to inject liquid nitrogen.
  • Circulation Fans: Fan_1 through Fan_3 must be active to ensure even heat transfer. If a fan fails (Fan state = 0), the cooling efficiency drops, triggering a logic alarm.
  • Safety Interlock: The system logic !gv_1 (Valve Closed) is the fail-safe state. If power is lost or the sensor fails, the valve must mechanically close to prevent nitrogen asphyxiation risks.

title: Boxing & Taping
alt: Boxing and Taping Machine State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Boxing & Taping Logic

Synchronizes the high-speed box erector with the taping sealer using accumulation logic.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Accumulation Conveyor: When PE_3 (Infeed Photo-Eye) is blocked (Logic 1) and the downstream indexing station is clear (PE_5 = 0), the conveyor motor MTR_C3 activates.
  • Pusher/Indexer: When the box reaches the staging area (PE_4 blocked) and the Taper is ready, the Pusher_Solenoid extends to insert the box into the sealer.
  • Jam Detection: If PE_4 remains blocked for > 3 seconds while the motor is running, the system enters a Fault State (Jam Detected), halting the Taper to prevent crushing the product.

title: Palletizer
alt: Palletizer State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Palletizer Logic

Manages the robotic stacking arm and pallet wrap initiation.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Rotation/Position Check: The robot verifies its physical orientation via encoders. Logic Rot == 225 confirms the arm is at the 'Pick' station.
  • Vacuum Gripper: When ps_5 (Box Present) is True and the arm is in position, the Vac_Grip solenoid activates. It only deactivates once the arm rotates to the 'Place' coordinates (Pos1, Pos2, or Pos3).
  • Pallet Complete: The PLC increments the integer Current_Layer_Count. When the total reaches 40, the system triggers the Wrapper_Start signal and releases the pallet to the stretch wrapper.

title: Wrapping Machine
alt: Wrapping Machine State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Wrapping Machine Logic

The final stage applying stretch film for shipping stability.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Cycle Start: The wrapper receives the 'Pallet Ready' handshake signal. The Turntable_Motor begins rotation only if the safety light curtain is clear.
  • Film Carriage: As the turntable rotates, the Film_Carriage moves vertically. The cycle continues until the Top_Limit_Switch is triggered.
  • Discharge: Upon cycle completion, Conveyor_5 activates to move the wrapped pallet to the warehouse fork-truck pickup zone.
